exhibit_title: AMENDMENT NUMBER FOUR TO GOOGLE SERVICES AGREEMENT
note: avenant n° 4 au contrat de services Google (effet au 1er août 2021) : durée jusqu'au 31 mars 2024, renouvelable jusqu'au 31 mars 2025 sauf préavis au plus tard le 31 mars 2023 ; annexes A et B remplacées ; avenant autonome, corps à lire en passe C (D-0036)
quote: This Amendment Number Four to the Google Services Agreement ("Amendment"), effective as of August 1, 2021 ("Amendment Effective Date"), is between Google LLC and Google Ireland Limited (collectively, "Google") and IAC/InterActiveCorp and IAC Search & Media Europe Limited (collectively, "Company") and amends the Google Services Agreement that has an effective date of April 1, 2016 (as amended, the "Agreement").
